section: Induction-Diffusion-Adsorption Process of Malachite Green for Cobalt Superconformal Electrodeposition
text: Xiaochuan Ma, 1 Yaqiang Li, 1 Penghui Ren, 1 Peixia Yang, 1 Jinqiu Zhang, 1 Maozhong An, 1,z and Wenquan Lv 2,z Cyclic voltammetry (CV), chronopotentiometry and quartz crystal microbalance were used to study the effect of Malachite Green (MG) on bottom-up growth of cobalt. The addition of MG not only inhibited the reduction of Co ^2 + but also accelerated the hydrogen evolution process. The metal reduction process was enhanced as well as the current efficiency was higher with the increase of pH. The bottom-up growth of cobalt can be achieved with the potential of −1.20 V.

section: Induction-Diffusion-Adsorption Process of Malachite Green for Cobalt Superconformal Electrodeposition
text: The metal reduction process was enhanced as well as the current efficiency was higher with the increase of pH. The bottom-up growth of cobalt can be achieved with the potential of −1.20 V. Induction-diffusion-adsorption superconformal electrodeposition mechanism was proposed to illustrate the synergistic effect of MG and pH on the growth of cobalt. On one hand, the MG concentration gradient and pH gradient could be formed to achieve a growth rate difference within blind vias so as to obtain bottom-up growth (diffusion-adsorption effect).

unit_id: 孔雀石绿诱导_扩散_吸附作用下的钴超共形电沉积过程#0087

text: At the initial state, the cathode surface covered with inhibitor MG which suppress the Co reduction and promote the HER. During the electrodeposition, the deposit suppression gradient was formed because of the diffusion-limited of MG. The passive-active transition zone come into being, and then the zone grows until it covers the entire trench due to the induction HER of MG. Meantime, the effective pH gradient is also established due to the mass transport limitation of hydrogen ion, resulting that the current efficiency at the bottom is higher, as shown in stage b in Fig. 10.

unit_id: 孔雀石绿诱导_扩散_吸附作用下的钴超共形电沉积过程#0088

text: Meantime, the effective pH gradient is also established due to the mass transport limitation of hydrogen ion, resulting that the current efficiency at the bottom is higher, as shown in stage b in Fig. 10. Compared with the formation of inhibition gradient, the disruption of MG caused by HER is weaker, which is more conducive to the bottom-up superfilling process. In summary, the induction-diffusion-adsorption mechanism, namely diffusion-adsorption effect caused by MG gradient and pH gradient as well as induction effect of MG on HER, was proposed to illustrate the bottom-up growth of cobalt.

section: Induction-Diffusion-Adsorption Process of Malachite Green for Cobalt Superconformal Electrodeposition > Conclusions
text: The additive Malachite Green (MG) was used as an effective suppressor for cobalt deposition. The suppressing effect of MG on cobalt electrodeposition was investigated according to cyclic voltammetry and the mass transport of MG is diffusion-controlled. The induction acceleration of MG on HER was obtained by coupling EQCM and cyclic voltammetry as well as surface morphology was used to confirm the acceleration of MG on HER, while the influence of pH on current efficiency was also studied.

text: The induction-diffusionadsorption mechanism was proposed to illustrate the bottom-up growth of cobalt. The MG gradient formed within blind vias due to the limitation of mass transport resulting the inhibition difference at different parts (the growth rate at the bottom is higher than that of the opening), while the pH gradient and the formation of CoOH^+ (ads) caused by MG induction is beneficial to the Cobalt filling in the feature.
